questions.prompt: What did the child learn before running and jumping?
questions.rationale: Page 2 says the child could sit up and crawl, while page 4 later says the child learned to run and jump.
questions.evidenceText: I grew bigger. I could sit up and crawl.

supportingEvidence.evidenceText: I learned to run and jump. I grew more every day.

questions.prompt: According to the book, what helps the body grow big and strong?
questions.evidenceText: Food helps my body get big and strong.

questions.prompt: What does the child say will happen one day?
questions.evidenceText: One day I will be tall!
